strings.language.title: LANGUAGE
strings.help.setup: Option 1 preserves launch options. Option 2 backs up and restores verified D3D12 settings and prepares IPv4, proxy and Steam networking without starting the game. Steam may restart. Setup is blocked during a game or installation.
strings.help.components: Uses installed FX, FEX and Proton-JE; no automatic compatibility-tool downloads or replacements. If FX uses a different mode, quit it normally before setup.
strings.help.language: Option 7 remembers the launcher language only; Steam and game language settings are unchanged.
strings.help.password: Option 8 edits or tests SSH. Optional password storage uses macOS Keychain, never JSON, logs or command arguments.
strings.help.keys: Arrows / Tab select, Enter confirms, Esc returns. M changes layout (immersive needs 80x25); 9 selects emblems and animation. Status updates every 10 seconds; R refreshes now, 3 runs full checks. 0 exits the launcher and leaves the game running.

strings.network.scope: Successful local profile: wired only, Wi-Fi off; FlClash global, TUN on, system proxy off, LAN proxy 7890 on. Game HTTPS keeps the Host proxy with TUN; Steam itself uses no HTTP proxy in TUN mode. This menu only changes/restores Wi-Fi, not FlClash, Mac IPv6 or credentials. Saved FlClash mode does not verify its live node. A full restart of this updated script still requires gameplay verification.

messages.\nInstructions\n1. Use option 1 for norm:
Instructions
1. Use option 1 for normal launches. It preserves your current game launch options.
2. Use option 2 for initial setup or to restore launch options: check the installed FX/FEX/Proton-JE, prepare IPv4, the proxy and Steam networking, then back up and save the verified D3D12 launch options.
   Setup does not start the game. Steam may restart if needed. Setup refuses to run while a game or installation step is active.
   If FX is stopped, it starts with the verified settings. If a running FX uses different settings, quit FX normally before setup.
3. Option 3 checks the environment; 4 exports a report; 5 opens the launcher folder.
4. A component version mismatch requires repair. Setup does not download or replace compatibility tools.
5. If automatic window switching fails, switch to FX manually. Choose Continue for the driver warning.
6. Menu 8 edits SSH settings, tests connections, and saves/removes Keychain passwords. Menu 9 selects an emblem. Initial setup runs only once.
7. Use ↑/↓, Return and Esc, or enter a number and press Return. Optional password storage uses macOS Keychain, never the settings file.
8. On the home screen use Left/Right to switch columns, Tab to cycle, and M to remember immersive/compact mode (80x25 minimum for immersive). Status refreshes every 10 seconds; R refreshes now, 3 runs full checks. Menu 9 → 7 also changes layout. Language is remembered.
Backups: launcher-20261026/backups. Reports: launcher-20261026/reports.
